description: This file contains unit tests for utility functions in the pipecat.utils.string module, specifically testing sentence boundary detection and start-end tag parsing with a focus on multilingual and edge cases.

classes.name: TestUtilsString
classes.description: Unit test class for string utility functions, covering sentence end detection across multiple languages and streaming token scenarios.

classes.name: TestStartEndTags
classes.description: Unit test class for parsing start and end tags within strings.

methods.name: test_endofsentence(self)
methods.description: Tests the match_endofsentence function with various sentence-ending punctuation and multilingual scripts.

methods.name: test_endofsentence_multilingual(self)
methods.description: Verifies sentence detection across multiple languages and scripts, including Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Myanmar, Bengali, Tamil, Armenian, Ethiopic, and Latin-script languages.

methods.name: test_endofsentence_streaming_tokens(self)
methods.description: Tests the behavior of match_endofsentence with streaming tokens, simulating incremental token input for sentence detection.

methods.name: test_empty(self)
methods.description: Tests parse_start_end_tags with empty input, expecting no matches.

methods.name: test_simple(self)
methods.description: Tests parse_start_end_tags with simple start and end tag pairs, including cases with incomplete tags.

methods.name: test_multiple(self)
methods.description: Tests parse_start_end_tags with multiple tags in a string to ensure correct matching and position calculation.
